what: The Video Converter changes a video from one format to another. Make an MP4 that plays on any phone, TV or website, a WebM for web pages, a MOV for Apple apps, or save just the sound as an MP3.

It can also fix common problems along the way: rotate a sideways video by 90 or 180 degrees, or remove the sound completely. When your video already uses the H.264 codec and you only need a different container, such as MOV to MP4, it is copied without re-encoding, which takes seconds and keeps full quality.
The conversion happens in your browser with a built-in copy of FFmpeg. Your video is never uploaded to a server.
uses: iPhone and camera videos are often MOV. Convert them to MP4 for Windows, Android, websites and upload forms.
WebM, MKV or AVI to MP4
Old or unusual formats may not play on your phone or TV. MP4 with H.264 and AAC plays almost everywhere.
WebM is an open format made for the web and works in all modern browsers.
Save a song or speech as MP3
Extract the sound from a recording of a lecture, a concert or an interview to listen on the go.
Rotate a phone video that was filmed the wrong way so it plays upright everywhere.
tutorial: Click "Click or drop a video here" or drag a video onto it. MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, WMV and FLV files up to 1 GB work. The first time, the video engine (about 32 MB) downloads and shows its progress.
Below the box you see the file name, size, length, width and height, and whether the video has sound.
In "Convert to" pick MP4 (H.264 + AAC), WebM (VP8 + Opus), MOV (H.264 + AAC) or MP3 (sound only). A note tells you when a fast copy without re-encoding is possible.
In "Rotate" choose 90° clockwise, 90° counter-clockwise or 180°. Rotation turns the picture itself, so it is the right way up in every player.
Remove the sound if you like
Tick "Remove sound" for a silent video. This option and Rotate are hidden when you choose MP3.
Click "Convert" (or "Extract MP3"). A progress bar shows the percentage and time taken, and Cancel stops the job. Keep the tab open while it works.
When it is done, a player shows the new video. Click the Download button to save it with the same name and the new extension, for example clip.mp4.
features: MP4, WebM, MOV and MP3, covering phones, the web, Apple apps and audio.
H.264 videos are moved into MP4 or MOV without re-encoding, in seconds, with no quality loss.
Turn videos 90° either way or 180°, re-encoded so every player shows them correctly.
Make a silent copy with one tick.
See exactly how far the conversion has got and stop it whenever you like.
Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

example.title: Worked example: an iPhone MOV for a Windows laptop
example.text: Your friend sends a 30-second iPhone video called party.mov that will not open on your old Windows laptop. You drop it in and the details show 1920 × 1080 with sound. You choose MP4 in Convert to, and the note says the video is already H.264 so it will be copied without re-encoding. You click Convert and about two seconds later click Download MP4 to save party.mp4, which is the same size and quality and plays in any player.

tips: Choose MP4 whenever you are unsure. It is the most widely supported video format.
Converting without rotation from an H.264 video to MP4 or MOV is instant; rotation always re-encodes and takes longer.
For long videos, convert on a computer: a browser uses only one processor core, and phones are slower.
To shrink the file at the same time, use the Video Compressor instead, which also makes an MP4.
MP3 output uses high quality variable bitrate, around 190 kbps, which is good for music and speech.
problems: It says the video has no sound track
You chose MP3 but the video is silent, so there is nothing to save. Pick a video format instead.
Re-encoding video takes a lot of work. Shorter clips, a lower resolution source, or a faster computer help. MOV to MP4 without rotation is much faster because nothing is re-encoded.
The video engine will not start
It needs about 32 MB the first time. Check your connection and use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
It stopped with an out of memory message
Very long or high resolution videos can use more memory than a browser tab allows. Trim the video first or use a computer.
The file could not be read
The video may be damaged, partly downloaded, or use a codec this tool cannot decode. Try playing it in another app first.
